Today is extra special. I just ended my 12-week internship at Salesforce with an incredible experience. And today also marks exactly two years since I packed my two bags from Ghana to pursue higher education at Grambling State University . If anyone had told me three years ago the people I’d meet and what I’d accomplish within these past two years, I would have had my doubts. It’s been a crazy journey; one that began with a decision to risk it all. And that decision made all the difference.

Law School to the United States Marine Corps: Over the past 10 weeks, I had the privilege of completing Officer Candidates School with the United States Marine Corps. Earning the title of Marine and commissioning as a Second Lieutenant was one of the most physically and mentally demanding experiences of my life. It tested my resilience, discipline, and ability to lead peers under pressure. As I return to my 3L year, I look forward to applying these lessons both in the classroom and in my future legal career as a Judge Advocate. The leadership, accountability, and commitment to service that define the Marine Corps will continue to shape the way I approach every challenge in life. I am grateful to my family, friends, mentors, and fellow candidates who supported me throughout this journey. It was a pleasure attending Officer Candidate School with fellow aspiring judge avocates and other peers. I’m excited for the road ahead. @ Patrick M. Semper Fidelis. #usmc #JudgeAdvocate

Earlier this week, we announced our $13.5M Series A, led by Standard Capital. What the announcement doesn't show is everything that happened before it: May 2024 - Andrew and I co-founded Weave after meeting at Causal, where he was the best engineer I'd ever worked with. We started with performance management analytics, pitched it to HR teams, and quickly found out they had no budget for it. May to October 2024 - We pivoted twice, couldn't land a customer either time, and couldn't close the seed round we were running in parallel. October 2024 - I cold-called three founders and got them to pay between $40 and $80 a month. That was our first bit of revenue. November 2024 - Launched on Hacker News. A multi-billion dollar company (can't disclose), connected all their GitHub repos to our platform without ever talking to us. The next morning: our YC interview. January to March 2025 - We went through YC W25 and grew from $80K to $300K ARR in 10 weeks. March 2025 - We closed our $4.2M seed with participation from Moonfire, Burst Capital, and Y Combinator. May 2026 - We launched the Weave Router. It reads your prompt and routes it to the most cost-effective model that can handle it. Companies are saving up to 80% on token spend. June 2026 - We signed one of our largest enterprise clients, Robinhood. Andrew pulled all-nighters to get our first enterprise on-prem deployment live. July 2026 - We closed our $13.5M Series A led by Standard Capital. Two years from zero customers to 100’s and 16 people, all in San Francisco, all in person. Back to shipping and selling :)
